g.text: American cyber operations, and may be in crime too
Chance that AI agents running whole intrusions are in
widespread use by each date, given that they are not yet
Criminals: widespread use in crime; solid line, if agents are a new business model; dashed, if a new tool (Chart 6). Agencies:
mainstream in US defence and intelligence agencies; band, models fitted with and without the generative-AI case, line, their mix
(Chart 8). Dates are the start of the year, so 2030 is the end of 2029. The cases behind both models are few and hand-picked: read
Sources: models of the adoption lags in Charts 6 and 8 (see their sources); author's Bayesian models
